// Generated by sova from trails/reject-wrong-password/trail.yaml
// Do not edit. Change the trail, then run `sova emit`.
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';

test('Reject wrong password', async ({ page }) => {
  await test.step('Open /', async () => {
    await page.goto('/');
  });

  await test.step('Enter the demo email', async () => {
    await page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Email', exact: true }).fill('ada@example.com');
  });

  await test.step('Enter an incorrect password', async () => {
    await page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Password', exact: true }).fill('wrong-password');
  });

  await test.step('Try to sign in', async () => {
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  });

  await test.step('Wrong password is rejected [spec: demo login]', async () => {
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert', { name: 'Wrong email or password', exact: true }).or(page.getByRole('alert').filter({ hasText: /^Wrong email or password$/ }))).toBeVisible();
  });
});
